status_note: Ferrari has confirmed Hamilton starts from the back; the others are as reported, pending the stewards' formal decisions.

penalties.reason: Fifth engine, turbo and exhaust of the season (30 places in total)
Fifth engine and turbo of the season
Whole new power unit after the FP3 smoke, on top of the 10-place penalty for his fifth engine
Fifth engine (ICE) of the season, one over the limit of four

incidents.text: Vibrations, then a loss of power and smoke in the cockpit about 35 minutes in, with a burning-oil smell from the rear. He pitted and missed the qualifying practice runs (7 laps, P12). Ferrari then fitted a whole new power unit, so he starts the race from the back. Cause not confirmed.
